chamber.title: Chamber dinner
chamber.detail: Suppliers still require their stated MOQ and delivery dates. A referral is not a guaranteed sale.

alumni.title: Alumni gathering
alumni.detail: A service job pays after delivery and its payment terms. Keep cash for the work and the wait.

port_festival.title: Port music festival
port_festival.detail: Hotel channels charge commission; an OTA placement still needs a truthful page and paying guests.

founders_mixer.title: Founders' mixer
founders_mixer.detail: Angels chat with founders over coffee. A first conversation is not an offer; pitching comes later and uses only your real figures.

trade_forum.title: Trade partners forum
trade_forum.detail: Distributors and food groups meet local suppliers. A partnership means real deliverables, a revenue share and sometimes exclusivity.

investors_gala.title: Aurelia Investors' Gala
investors_gala.detail: Black-tie dinner for backers and founders. The door asks for formal dress; meeting an angel here is a conversation, not funding.

maker_market.title: Maker market
maker_market.detail: Studios and shops share stalls. Co-brand ideas start here and become contracts only when you sign them.

lean.label: Quick version: cover the essentials yourself and finish sooner

hire.label: Pay a freelancer to prepare it while you keep working
